title: A Design system press is one Site changes row on every CMS (WordPress's own files no longer a second 'source unknown' row), reads Type 'Design system' / 'Applied by <person>' with distinct apply, switch and undo sentences in eight languages, and a failure inside tracy-web's WebSocket upgrade handshake no longer ends the process
steps: S1/S2 without a database: node --test apps/tracy-host/test/ds-slot.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/design-system-door.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/upgrade-listener.test.mjs packages/core/tracy-core/test/activity-v2.test.mjs

S1/S2 on Postgres: TEST_DATABASE_URL=<url> node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='Design system|chat route’s apply stays Chat|replay of the stand' apps/tracy-web/test/site-activity-v2.test.mjs
S2: read the five new keys in the seven translated tracy-site-tabs.json files and the committed bundles.
expect: S1: a WordPress apply answers files ['wp-content/uploads/tracy/styles/ds-od-<id>.json', 'wp-content/uploads/tracy/inspirations.json'] (EmDash and Joomla: []); the door keeps them on the site_write target; GET /api/sites/:key/activity?version=2 lists one writes row per press and no outside-files row for a seal holding only those files (counts.unknown 0), and the row carries effects.files {count: 2, sha: <seal>}. A seal with one more file, sealed before the press, or of a press with no files or an unknown outcome stays its own Unknown row.

S2: the press's row has origin.source 'design-system', actor.role 'executor', no executor, and description keys design-system.apply {name}, design-system.switch {name, from}, design-system.undo {name}; the chat route's apply (target.channel 'chat') and a row recorded before the channel stay 'chat'. en: 'Applied the design system “Stripe”', 'Switched the design system from “Stripe” to “Spotify”', 'Undid the design system “Spotify”'; vi, de, it, fr, nl, zh, es carry all five keys.

S3: the upgrade listener resolves (never rejects) when resolver.canonicalize or seatFor throws EAI_AGAIN, destroys that socket and logs one '[ws] handshake for … dropped: EAI_AGAIN …' line; a client socket error while it awaits throws nothing.

selectors.activity: GET /api/sites/:key/activity?version=2 -> writes item origin.source 'design-system', description.key design-system.*

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-walkthrough-2026-10-11/README.md bugs 3, 4, 5 (A-wordpress/14-site-changes.png, 15-site-changes-apply-row.png, 15b-site-changes-unknown-row.png); the WordPress paths were computed with the new script lines in dswalkwp01-web-1 (read only).
fence: The Site changes rows are read on Postgres with seeded site_write / site_outside / site_design_system rows, not through the stand's deployed image (it runs the branch from before this fix and is rebuilt by the integrator). The WordPress script's two new lines were run read-only in the stand's WordPress container; the real write was not pressed. One test replays the stand's own rows for dswalkwp01 (site_write 6433/6434, seal 3c735935…, read only from tracy-postgres-1) with the fields the door now records.
